result.instructions: Tools for Messente, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How much SMS credit do I have left on my account?"; "What does one SMS to Estonia cost on each mobile network?"; "How many texts did we send last month, and what did they cost per country?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Messente data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run messente_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run messente_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run messente_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. messente_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: messente_get_balance
tools.title: Get account balance
tools.description: Get the Messente account's remaining SMS credit balance (in EUR). Messente legacy API: GET /get_balance (api2.messente.com).

tools.name: messente_get_prices
tools.title: Get SMS prices for a country
tools.description: Get this account's price per SMS part for one country, per mobile network (use it to estimate what messente_send_sms will cost). Messente legacy API: GET /prices.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. EE or GB.

annotations.title: Get SMS prices for a country

tools.name: messente_get_delivery_status
tools.title: Get delivery status of a message
tools.description: Get the delivery report of a sent message by its omnimessage id (returned by messente_send_sms): per-message status (DELIVRD, UNDELIV, FAILED, ...), error and the price charged. Messente asks not to poll this for every message at scale. Messente: GET /omnimessage/{omnimessage_id}/status.

omnimessage_id.description: The omnimessage_id returned when the message was sent.

annotations.title: Get delivery status of a message

tools.name: messente_list_blacklist
tools.title: List blacklisted numbers
tools.description: List the phone numbers on the account's blacklist (numbers Messente will not send to). Returns the total count and at most `limit` numbers. Messente: GET /phonebook/blacklist.

offset.description: Skip this many numbers (to page through a long list).

tools.name: messente_check_blacklist
tools.title: Check if a number is blacklisted
tools.description: Check whether one phone number is on the account's blacklist. Messente: GET /phonebook/blacklist/{phone} (found = blacklisted, 404 = not).

phone.description: Phone number in E.164 format, e.g. +37251000000.

annotations.title: Check if a number is blacklisted

tools.name: messente_get_statistics
tools.title: Get message statistics
tools.description: Get total messages and total price per country for a date range, optionally for some message types. Messente: POST /statistics/reports (a read-only report).

message_types.description: Limit the report to these message types.

tools.name: messente_lookup_numbers
tools.title: Look up phone numbers (HLR)
tools.description: Number lookup (HLR): is each number valid, ported, roaming, and which network it is on. COSTS CREDITS: Messente charges per number looked up (EUR 0.002 per number in its docs) and the Number Lookup service must be enabled on the account (a fixed monthly fee applies per Messente's docs). Up to 10 numbers per call. Messente: POST /hlr/sync.

tools.name: messente_add_to_blacklist
tools.title: Add a number to the blacklist
tools.description: WRITE: add one phone number to the account's blacklist, so Messente will no longer send messages to it. Adding a number already listed is harmless. Messente: POST /phonebook/blacklist.

phone_number.description: Phone number to blacklist, E.164 format, e.g. +37251000000.

annotations.title: Add a number to the blacklist

tools.name: messente_send_sms
tools.title: Send an SMS
tools.description: WRITE: SENDS REAL SMS TEXT MESSAGES to real people and SPENDS the account's Messente credit (each recipient is charged per SMS part, longer texts use several parts; use messente_get_prices to estimate). SMS only, at most 10 recipients per call, one message per recipient, never to a list. Send only to people who asked to receive it (Messente forbids unsolicited messages). Not undoable. Messente: POST /omnimessage with channel sms, once per recipient.

to.description: Recipient phone numbers in E.164 format (1-10).

sender.description: Sender name (alphanumeric, max 11 chars) or number; must be a sender verified on the account. Omit to use the account default.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Messente
prompts.description: What you can do with Messente here, with example requests to try.
